content.comment_body: In [product_name], adjusting the page setup from portrait to landscape and changing print settings in the options menu (such as zoom) does not result in any apparent change. These adjustments only have an effect when modifying zoom in the print preview. The issue was observed on Windows 10 64-bit and with [product_name] [version_no].
Switching between portrait and landscape only takes effect during printing.

analysis.insight_summary: The user notes that modifying page orientation and print settings within [product_name] does not provide immediate visual feedback in the main view, and the changes only become visible in print preview or when printing. This has caused confusion about how and when these settings are applied.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that adjustments to page orientation and print settings should be instantly visible within the software interface, rather than only appearing in print preview or during the printing process.
